name: Hook, Line, and Axe
detailed_description:
Hook, Line, and Axe is a third person hack-and-slash parkour set in a dystopian America. In this fictional world, nothing is truly as it seems, and a tyrannical government has corrupted far more than anyone suspected. It’s up to you, an Insurrectionist and conspiracy theorist, to put a stop to them once and for all. With nothing more than a battle axe, take the fight to the military at Area 51. Talk about bringing an axe to a gunfight!

Upon discovering a high-tech grapple hook inside, you must swing around to traverse this dangerous terrain, find collectibles, unleash a full arsenal of combat abilities at your disposal, and unlock secrets on the most dangerous and unpredictable mission the world has ever seen in Hook, Line, and Axe.

Hook, Line, and Axe currently is a standalone game that serves as a "Part One" to the story. There WILL be a Part Two, Sequel, or DLC should the game receive adequate funding or a significant amount of interest. Until then, our small group of developers hopes you enjoy the game in its current capacity!

Warning: Game contains some stylized violence and may contain content that is too mature for some users.

short_description: Swing into action in this third-person hack-and-slash parkour set in a sci-fi dystopian America. Strike down corruption with your trusty battle axe. Grapple onto enemies and the environment alike. Chain abilities for the ultimate combo of destruction in Hook, Line, and Axe.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit 1909 revision .1350 or higher
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 or AMD Ryzen 5 or above
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce RTX 3050
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit 1909 revision .1350 or higher
  • Processor: Intel Core i7 or AMD Ryzen 7 or above
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce RTX 3060
